stem: How did this document contribute to the growth of representative government?

options.label: A
options.text: It defined the relationship between the branches of government.

options.label: B
options.text: It set forth the idea that colonists would agree to a government by majority rule.

options.label: C
options.text: It defined the relationship between the colonists and the founding company.

options.label: D
options.text: It set forth the idea that a separation should exist between the church and the state.

visual_elements: We, whose names are underwritten . . . do enact, [form], and frame, such just and equal Laws, Ordinances, Acts, Constitutions, and Officers, from time to time, . . . for the general Good of the Colony; unto which we promise all due Submission and Obedience. —Mayflower Compact, 1620
